↳ Posted by Steve Owen on July 14th, 2015.

Converter problem?

Thanks Steve,
In the second bar of the X:3 B part this expression “[GB]>A” doesn’t seem to convert the same way it does in Easy ABC or Mandolintab.net converter. I intended this to be two dotted 1/8th notes played as a double stop followed by a 1/16 note. That’s how it comes out in other converters but here it comes out as two dotted 1/8ths followed by a half-note… I don’t have an answer for that but it sure messes the timing up. Does anyone have an answer as to why this works this way for just this converter? Jeremy?

You can get the proper timing by pasting the ABC from X:3 into Easy ABC or the converter on mandolin.net.
